items.first_line: [A10] **Lane assignment.** Executor [A607], branch `730-act-cpusets` from dev `dc4d06cb`. Internal review R632, external review R633. The maintainer asked for faster CI (2026-10-12, "ok improve ci").

[A10] **Disk note for this lane (measured 2026-10-12).** Each isolated slot keeps its own data-root under `/var/lib/milan-act-ci/slot-N`, holding a full copy of the runner image and the seeded tool cache. That is about 64-70 GB per slot. On this host the data-roots sit on the root filesystem, which is shared with the default daemon's own 53 GB copy. Two slots filled it to 100 %, and slot 1's cache has been removed. Slot 3, your measurement slot, is the only slot cache that may exist during this lane. Delete `/var/lib/milan-act-ci/slot-3` when your measurement ends (`sudo rm -rf`, with no slot-3 daemon running), and record its size before deletion. The CPU change in this issue gives one replay its speed; parallel slots need their data-roots moved off the root disk first, and that is out of scope here.

[A10] **Ruling: no replays inside this lane.** The slot-3 "before" replay was stopped at 22:10 and its data-root deleted. A slot's image cache took 64-70 GB on the root filesystem, and the root disk was filling at about 1.4 GB per minute. Executor [A607].
